descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name referring to Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's trusted counselor who defected to Absalom's rebellion (2 Samuel 15-17). English 'Achitophel / Ahithophel / and–Achitophel,' Spanish 'Ajitofel / y–Ajitofel / Y–Ahitofel,' Hindi 'अहीतोपेल / और–अहीतोपेल,' Arabic 'أَخيتُوفَل / وَ–أَخِيتُوفَلُ,' Korean '아히도벨이 / 아히도벨,' Swahili 'Ahithofeli / na–Ahithofeli.' The two clusters differ only in presence or absence of the conjunctive waw prefix; the referent is the same historical person throughout all 20 occurrences.
